health.title: Account Health
health.subtitle: Accounts scored at risk or critical, ordered by urgency.
health.truncated: Showing the first {count} at-risk accounts. There may be more.
health.emptyMessage: Accounts appear here once they are scored at risk or critical.

designer.issueHoaMissing: Head of Account is missing — payments cannot post without it.
designer.issueFeeMissing: The fee is not saved for the chosen fee model.
designer.issueSignatoryMissing: No signatory chosen — an issued document needs a named authority.
designer.issueDocNoLane: {count} mandatory document(s) have no verifying step.
designer.helpB5: Set how much applicants pay, which account receives it, and when the demand is raised. Blocks Next: Head of Account and the fee amount are required before you can continue.
designer.helpB6: List what applicants must upload and which approval step verifies each document. Warning: a mandatory document without a verifying step does not block Next, and is listed on the review page.
designer.helpB7: Design what citizens receive (certificate, licence, closure note or receipt): template, numbering, signatory and validity. Blocks Next: a signatory is required for everything except a receipt.
designer.feeBlockMessage: Define the fee before you continue — a fee model needs an amount.
designer.docRetentionYears: Keep for {years} years after the application closes
designer.docRetentionAfterVerification: Delete the copy once it is verified; keep only the verification record
designer.docSensitiveNote: Sensitive: ask only for what is needed and never show the full number on screen.
designer.sigMethodNote: Both DSC and Aadhaar eSign are valid under the IT Act, 2000. Court orders always use a DSC token; this setting does not change that.
